name: Metals
overview: Scripture highlights the significance of metals such as gold, silver, brass, and lead, illustrating their value and practical uses in the ancient world. The land of Havilah is noted for its abundant and good-quality gold, emphasizing God's provision (Genesis 2:11-12). Metals were not only treasured for their worth but also shaped into objects of utility and worship, as seen in the overlaying of horns with brass in the tabernacle (Exodus 27:2) and the use of silver cups in daily life (Genesis 44:2). Additionally, the imagery of lead sinking in water (Exodus 15:10) reflects both the physical properties and symbolic roles metals held in biblical narrative.
